description: This file defines command handling and task status display functions for a chat or automation system, including formatting task details, building task summaries, and handling the /tasks command.

methods.name: formatTaskHeadline
methods.description: Generates a headline string summarizing the current task snapshot for a session.

methods.name: formatAgentFallbackLine
methods.description: Creates a fallback line summarizing agent-local tasks if no session tasks are linked.

methods.name: formatTaskTiming
methods.description: Returns a string describing the timing of a task based on its status and timestamps.

methods.name: formatTaskDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a task.

methods.name: formatVisibleTask
methods.description: Formats a task into a string for display, including icon, title, status, timing, and details.
